mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_pending_action (id, action_type, product_id, plan_id, qty, before_qty, after_qty, exception_flag, warning, actor, status, memo, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actionType}, #{productId}, #{planId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{qty}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{exceptionFlag}, #{warning, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor}, #{status}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, action_type, product_id, plan_id, qty, before_qty, after_qty, exception_flag, warning, actor, status, memo, created_at, expires_at, decided_at FROM erp_pending_action WHERE id = #{id}
